name: Incident opened to Teams
description: Card for every Power Platform, Dataverse or Copilot service incident, any severity (spec §7)

name: Incident resolved to Teams
description: Card when a service incident is resolved

name: High or Critical rating to Teams
description: Card when a live estate rating (override when set) is High or Critical (spec §7)

name: Deadline to Teams
description: Card when an action-required date with live exposure is 14 or 3 days away (spec §7)

name: New signals in the digest
description: Monday digest: new signals

name: Changed signals in the digest
description: Monday digest: changed dates, wording or status (roadmap slips)

name: Exposures in the digest
description: Monday digest: newly exposed assets

name: Ratings in the digest
description: Monday digest: new and changed ratings

name: Model change to Teams
description: Card when a live agent's or prompt's model moves to another model without anyone editing it (ADR 0013)

name: Model changes in the digest
description: Monday digest: agents and prompts whose model moved (ADR 0013)

name: Watch matches to Teams
description: Card when a new or changed signal matches a watch list topic and goes on the watch list (ADR 0015)

name: Watched item updates to Teams
description: Card when a signal on the watch list changes: dates, status, title or wording (ADR 0015)

name: Watch matches in the digest
description: Monday digest: signals added to the watch list (ADR 0015)

name: Watched item updates in the digest
description: Monday digest: watched signals that changed (ADR 0015)

name: Incident opened by email
description: Email for every Power Platform, Dataverse or Copilot service incident, to each email: destination (ADR 0011 addendum; enable with the Notify-Email flow)

name: Incident resolved by email
description: Email when a service incident is resolved (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: High or Critical rating by email
description: Email when a live estate rating (override when set) is High or Critical (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Deadline by email
description: Email when an action-required date with live exposure is 14 or 3 days away (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Model change by email
description: Email when a live agent's or prompt's model moves without anyone editing it (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Watch matches by email
description: Email when a signal goes on the watch list (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Watched item updates by email
description: Email when a watched signal changes (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: New signals in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: new signals (ADR 0011 addendum; enable with the Digest-Email flow)

name: Changed signals in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: changed signals (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Exposures in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: newly exposed assets (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Ratings in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: new and changed ratings (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Model changes in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: agents and prompts whose model moved (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Watch matches in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: signals added to the watch list (ADR 0011 addendum)

name: Watched item updates in the email digest
description: Weekly email digest: watched signals that changed (ADR 0011 addendum)
